svg.title: Newton - network engineer for AI agents
svg.desc: The Newton planet mark beside a blueprint diagram: the Newton agent hub, guarded by a dashed ring and shield, linked to OpenWrt router, Wi-Fi, VLANs, Firewall, DHCP / DNS, Dual-WAN, Linux host and serial console nodes.

g.text: Change a router. Prove it. Roll back if it broke.
Built with safeguards: automatic rollback · fresh-connection verify · human approval · no raw shell
